newsitem.title: USA: EMC says no revisions in Seagate procurement.
newsitem.headline: EMC says no revisions in Seagate procurement.

text.p: EMC Corp said Tuesday there have been no changes in its procurement plans from Seagate Technologies Inc.
The company said it has not revised its guidance for its June 1997 quarter. The First Call consensus estimate for the quarter is $0.48 per share.
The company said bookings for the first and second quarters are ahead of last year.

The announcement followed a warning Monday from Seagate that its fiscal fourth quarter results are expected to fall below expectations because of weak demand for its high-performance computer disk-drive products.
Seagate shares fell to 38-1/8 from 40-5/8 in early trading Tuesday.
